what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Mozambique: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6378 asylum seekers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Mozambique, 3.8% of all asylum seekers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a separate group, live mostly in Uganda, Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1996 to 2025, with M23 among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025 and over Katanga territory in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1238 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 8594, at the end of 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data include 2013 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mozambique.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Mozambique only.
